edura.metaTitle: EDURA LMS — UI/UX concept · Tran Vu Anh Duy
edura.metaDescription: The final UX/UI semester project at Arena Multimedia: an EDURA LMS concept and Figma prototype. Lead UI scope, interface decisions and the project's constraints.

intro.heading: EDURA LMS
intro.body: EDURA is a Figma UI/UX concept and prototype for a learning-management platform serving learners at training centers. The design aims to bring schedules, grades, tuition and assignments into one place.

role.heading: Role: Lead UI
role.body: As Lead UI, I made decisions about EDURA’s layout rules, primary color direction and interface system design.

framing.heading: Learning information across multiple channels
framing.body: The project materials frame a problem of schedules, materials and submission deadlines spread across multiple channels. EDURA’s proposed direction is to bring this information together in a learner interface.

layout.heading: Layout rules
layout.body: I was responsible for decisions about layout rules. In the overview, entry points for grades, schedules, tuition and courses appear together, with attendance and learning progress below.

color.heading: Primary color direction
color.body: I was responsible for the primary color direction. The EDURA materials show blue in the identity and interface, alongside light surfaces and distinct colors for function groups in the overview.

system.heading: Interface system design
system.body: Interface system design was part of my Lead UI scope for the EDURA concept and Figma prototype.

overview.body: The EDURA mockup presents information and actions for grades, schedules, tuition, courses, attendance, assignments, submission and progress. It is a design overview rather than a screen sequence documenting a complete interaction flow.

direction.body: The concept materials propose centralized learning information, a progress dashboard and support tailored to training centers. These descriptions document design intent, without establishing operational features or measured impact.

deliverables.heading: Concept and prototype deliverables
deliverables.body: The design takes the form of a UI/UX concept and Figma prototype.

edura.context: The final project for the UX/UI semester at Arena Multimedia.

reflection.heading: Project reflection
reflection.prototype: Partway through the project, the team was short of one member, which held up prototype work for a period.
reflection.references: The project also had few references from LMS products with publicly available information and interfaces.
